svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.23.12.2 Openings in Loadbearing Walls
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.23 WOOD-FRAME CONSTRUCTION

text.tspan: Opening wider than the stud spacing

g.text: Lintel carries the superimposed loads to the
Lintel over an opening in a loadbearing wall
2 or more members: 82 mm nails, double row,
450 mm or less apart in each row, (2)
Lintel members separated by a filler piece, (3)

svg.text: Openings in loadbearing walls greater than the
required stud spacing are framed with lintels
designed to carry the superimposed loads to
where 2 or more members are used in lintels,
they are fastened together with not less than
82 mm nails in a double row, with nails not
more than 450 mm apart in each row.
Lintel members are permitted to be separated
Drawn: lintels and filler in yellow, loads as red arrows, nails as dots. C: front member cut back to show the filler. Sizes are illustration only.
